'''Stoke''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] who lived as a [[krill farmer]] in a [[Unidentified village (Sorgan)|small village]] on the [[planet]] [[Sorgan]]. He went with another [[farmer]] from his village, [[Caben]], to try to convince [[Mandalorian]] [[bounty hunter]] [[Din Djarin]] to deal with raiders taking their harvest. The pair offered to pay the bounty hunter with a monetary reward offered by the members of the village.<ref name="Chapter 4" />
